title: 150 MeV Proton Bragg Peak in Water Phantom
description: Monoenergetic 150 MeV clinical proton beam impinging on a 30x30x40 cm Geant4 G4_WATER phantom with a DoseToWater depth-dose Bragg peak scorer.
code:
# TOPAS 150 MeV Proton Therapy Bragg Peak in Water Phantom
s:Ge/World/Material = "G4_AIR"
d:Ge/World/HLX = 1.0 m
d:Ge/World/HLY = 1.0 m
d:Ge/World/HLZ = 1.0 m

s:Ge/WaterPhantom/Type = "TsBox"
s:Ge/WaterPhantom/Parent = "World"
s:Ge/WaterPhantom/Material = "G4_WATER"
d:Ge/WaterPhantom/HLX = 15.0 cm
d:Ge/WaterPhantom/HLY = 15.0 cm
d:Ge/WaterPhantom/HLZ = 20.0 cm
d:Ge/WaterPhantom/TransZ = 200.0 mm

s:So/ProtonBeam/Type = "Beam"
s:So/ProtonBeam/Component = "BeamPosition"
s:So/ProtonBeam/BeamParticle = "proton"
d:So/ProtonBeam/BeamEnergy = 150.0 MeV
u:So/ProtonBeam/BeamEnergySpread = 0.5
i:So/ProtonBeam/NumberOfHistoriesInRun = 50000

s:Sc/BraggPeakDose/Quantity = "DoseToWater"
s:Sc/BraggPeakDose/Component = "WaterPhantom"
i:Sc/BraggPeakDose/ZBins = 200
b:Sc/BraggPeakDose/OutputToConsole = "True"

title: GATE PET Cylindrical Scintillator Detector Ring
description: Geant4/GATE nuclear medicine PET macro defining a cylindrical water emission phantom, positron-annihilation 511 keV gamma source, and attached dose/energy deposition actor.
code:
# GATE Cylindrical PET Scanner & 511 keV Annihilation Phantom Macro
/gate/world/daughters/name PetPhantom
/gate/world/daughters/insert cylinder
/gate/PetPhantom/setMaterial G4_WATER
/gate/PetPhantom/geometry/setRmin 0. mm
/gate/PetPhantom/geometry/setRmax 100. mm
/gate/PetPhantom/geometry/setHeight 200. mm
/gate/PetPhantom/placement/setTranslation 0. 0. 0. mm

/gate/world/daughters/name ScintillatorRing
/gate/world/daughters/insert cylinder
/gate/ScintillatorRing/setMaterial G4_BONE_COMPACT_ICRU
/gate/ScintillatorRing/geometry/setRmin 380. mm
/gate/ScintillatorRing/geometry/setRmax 410. mm
/gate/ScintillatorRing/geometry/setHeight 180. mm
/gate/ScintillatorRing/placement/setTranslation 0. 0. 0. mm

/gate/source/addSource F18Source gps
/gate/source/F18Source/gps/particle gamma
/gate/source/F18Source/gps/ene/mono 0.511 MeV
/gate/source/F18Source/gps/ene/sigma 0.005 MeV

/gate/actor/addActor DoseActor PetCrystalHits
/gate/actor/PetCrystalHits/attachTo ScintillatorRing
